payload.prompt: A tall natural rock chamber, seen in a first-person view at standing eye height, its walls rising up out of the light. The walls are orange stone in smooth wavy bands that curve across them. On the right, away from the edge of the frame, a sloping rocky canyon runs away out of the picture between rock walls. On the left, away from the edge of the frame, a rock passage opens in the wall and runs away out of the picture. In the floor of the passage on the left, a round pit in the rock gives off wisps of white mist. The floor of the chamber in the foreground is bare orange rock. A pool of warm lamplight from just behind the camera falls on the middle of the chamber, and the rock walls at the sides and above fade into darkness. The picture fills the whole frame, edge to edge. Setting: a medieval fantasy world; everything is old and handmade: weathered stone and old brick, rough timber, wrought iron. Style: 1970s comic book art: bold black ink outlines, hand-inked hatching, flat printed colours with visible halftone dots, slightly off-register colour printing, muted earthy palette of browns, ochres, olive and amber, on aged newsprint. Mood: quiet, still and mysterious, a place long left alone.
